answer:
Your records show two medications that are currently active:

1. Jardiance (empagliflozin) 10 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once daily in the morning. Prescribed 20 Feb 2025, for your diabetes.
2. Atorvastatin 20 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once daily. Prescribed 20 Feb 2025, for cholesterol.

Metformin 500 mg is no longer on your list. It was recorded as ended on 15 Apr 2024, so don't count it as a current medicine. The records don't say why it stopped.

These lists only show what was prescribed. I can't tell from them whether you are actually taking each one, whether doses have changed, or whether you take anything from outside this hospital, such as over-the-counter medicines or supplements. Please confirm that with your doctor or pharmacist.
